name: io.github.headroomdesk/calculators
title: Headroom Desk options calculators
description: Exact options P/L at expiry, Black-Scholes, Greeks and covered-call/put returns on your numbers.

tools.name: options_pnl_at_expiry
tools.description: Exact P/L at expiry for a position of up to 8 legs (calls, puts, shares, long or short): net premium (debit or credit), breakevens, highest and lowest P/L at expiry (or Unlimited), and the P/L at each strike and at any underlying prices given. Covers spreads, straddles, strangles, iron condors, butterflies, covered calls and collars. Uses only the numbers supplied.

type.description: The leg: a call option, a put option, or shares of the underlying stock.

side.description: long = bought (premium paid), short = written or sold short (premium received).

quantity.description: Contracts for an option, shares for stock.

price.description: Premium per share for an option, or the price paid per share for stock.

legs.description: The position: 1 to 8 legs (calls, puts or shares, long or short).

items.description: Dollars per share, at most 4 decimals, for example "2.35".

prices_at_expiry.description: Optional underlying prices at expiry to evaluate.

tools.name: options_pnl_before_expiry
tools.description: Black-Scholes model estimate of a position's P/L a given number of days from now at a given underlying price, for up to 8 legs. Each option leg needs its days to expiry and volatility. The interest rate and dividend yield must be supplied; nothing is built in.

type.description: The leg: a call option, a put option, or shares of the underlying stock.

side.description: long = bought (premium paid), short = written or sold short (premium received).

quantity.description: Contracts for an option, shares for stock.

price.description: Premium per share for an option, or the price paid per share for stock.

days_to_expiry.description: Calendar days from now to this option's expiry (options only).

volatility_pct.description: Volatility per year in percent for this option, for example 30 (options only).

legs.description: The position: 1 to 8 legs; each option leg also needs days_to_expiry and volatility_pct.

underlying_price.description: Underlying price in dollars at which to value the position.

days_from_now.description: Calendar days from now; not after any leg's expiry.

rate_pct.description: Interest rate per year in percent, continuously compounded (0 is allowed).

dividend_yield_pct.description: Dividend yield per year in percent, continuous (0 is allowed).

tools.name: black_scholes
tools.description: Black-Scholes model value of one European-style call or put per share and per 100-share contract, with delta, gamma, theta per calendar day, vega per volatility point and rho per rate point. All inputs, including the interest rate and dividend yield, must be supplied.

volatility_pct.description: Volatility per year in percent, for example 30.

rate_pct.description: Interest rate per year in percent (0 is allowed).

dividend_yield_pct.description: Dividend yield per year in percent (0 is allowed).

tools.name: implied_volatility
tools.description: The Black-Scholes volatility at which the model value equals a given option price, or a message when no volatility fits that price. All inputs, including the interest rate and dividend yield, must be supplied.

option_price.description: Option price per share in dollars.

rate_pct.description: Interest rate per year in percent (0 is allowed).

dividend_yield_pct.description: Dividend yield per year in percent (0 is allowed).

tools.name: covered_call
tools.description: For 100 shares per contract with one call written against them: net debit, breakeven at expiry, return if called and if not called (each with its per-year figures), highest and lowest P/L at expiry.

share_price.description: Price per share paid for the stock (or its price now), in dollars, e.g. "50".

call_strike.description: Strike of the call written against the shares, in dollars.

premium.description: Premium received per share for the call.

days_to_expiry.description: Calendar days until the call expires.

contracts.description: Number of contracts; each covers 100 shares. Default 1.

tools.name: cash_secured_put
tools.description: For a put written with cash set aside to take 100 shares per contract at the strike: cash secured, breakeven and cost per share if assigned, return on the cash with its per-year figures, highest and lowest P/L at expiry.

put_strike.description: Strike of the put written, in dollars.

premium.description: Premium received per share for the put.

days_to_expiry.description: Calendar days until the put expires.

contracts.description: Number of contracts; each secures 100 shares. Default 1.

tools.name: covered_call_roll
tools.description: Closing a written call and writing a new one: net credit or debit of the roll, total premium kept, new breakeven, return if called at the new strike with its per-year figures, highest and lowest P/L at the new expiry.

share_cost.description: What the shares cost per share, in dollars.

premiums_received_so_far.description: Premiums kept so far per share (default 0).

cost_to_close.description: Cost per share to close the current call (default 0).

new_premium.description: Premium per share received for the new call.

new_strike.description: Strike of the new call, in dollars.

days_to_new_expiry.description: Calendar days until the new call expires.

contracts.description: Number of contracts; each covers 100 shares. Default 1.

tools.name: annualized_return
tools.description: Turns a return over a number of calendar days into per-year figures, simple and compounded, shown beside the period return.

return_pct.description: Return over the period in percent; a loss with a minus, not below -100.
